title: DFEClkFwd
text: DFE with Clock Forwarding in the receiver AMI model, 1 input, 1 output, {Mode} sets DFE operating mode; {Initial tap weights (V)} sets the initial DFE tap weights, {Adaptive gain} Controls DFE tap weight update, {Adaptive step size (V)} sets the dFE adaptive step, {Minimum DFE tap value (V)} sets the minimum value of adapted taps, {Maximum DFE tap value (V)} sets the maximum value of adapted taps, {2x tap weights} sets the multiply DFE tap weights by a factor, {Phase offset (symbol time)} sets the manual clock phase offset, {Reference offset (ppm)} sets the reference clock offset impairment, {Early/late count threshold} sets the early or late CDR count threshold to trigger phase, {Step (symbol time)} sets the clock phase resolution and {Sensitivity (V)} sets the sampling latch metastability voltage. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Mode
params.values: DFE operating mode Fixed (default) | Off | Adapt

params.name: Initial tap weights (V)
params.values: Initial DFE tap weights [0 0 0 0] (default) | row vector

params.name: Adaptive gain
params.values: Controls DFE tap weight update rate 9.6e-5 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Adaptive step size (V)
params.values: DFE adaptive step resolution 1e-06 (default) | nonnegative real scalar | nonnegative real-valued row vector

params.name: Minimum DFE tap value (V)
params.values: Minimum value of adapted taps -1 (default) | real scalar | real-valued row vector

params.name: Maximum DFE tap value (V)
params.values: Maximum value of adapted taps 1 (default) | nonnegative real scalar | nonnegative real-valued row vector

params.name: 2x tap weights
params.values: Multiply DFE tap weights by a factor of two on (default) | off

params.name: Phase offset (symbol time)
params.values: Manual clock phase offset 0 (default) | real scalar in the range [−0.5, 0.5]

params.name: Reference offset (ppm)
params.values: Reference clock offset impairment 0 (default) | real scalar in the range [−300, 300]

params.name: Early/late count threshold
params.values: Early or late CDR count threshold to trigger phase update 5 (default) | positive real integer ≥5

params.name: Sensitivity (V)
params.values: Sampling latch metastability voltage 0 (default) | real scalar
